\chapter{线性代数}\label{chap:linalg}

% A macro defined inside a chapter: the renderer reads this file too.
\newcommand{\Lip}{L}

\begin{proposition}{半正定 Positive semidefinite}{psd}
  若所有 $\lambda_i \ge 0$，则 $x^\top A x \ge 0$，且 $\Lip = \ceil{\lambda_{\max}}$。
\end{proposition}

\begin{gather}
  \Tr(AB) = \Tr(BA), \label{eq:trace} \\
  \begin{mat} 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 \end{mat} = I.
\end{gather}
